The '''Laman system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Southern Core]] regions.<ref name="Southern Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Laman system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square L-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
